newsitem.title: UK: ONS revises index of industrial production data.
newsitem.headline: ONS revises index of industrial production data.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics published an new set of index of industrial production data on Monday.

The new figures have the effect of raising the levels of the overall manufacturing and production series after 1990 but generally maintain the previous annual and quarterly growth rates, the ONS said.
The new index of industrial production for the first quarter of 1997 is 108.4, compared with 107.8 under the old data set. The quarterly change is -0.18 percent in both cases.
